name: starfield
title: Starfield
description: A night sky behind a hero: still stars, a share of them breathing, an occasional shooting star and a few slow meteors. Everything is painted on ONE `<canvas>` driven by ONE animation frame loop, so the whole sky costs a single layer and a single callback…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/starfield

Installed to `components/ui/effects/starfield.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/starfield';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/starfield

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
